purpose: Calibrate report format, message coexistence, parser thresholds, zoom semantics, security/password distinction, linearization and font inspection before executing the full 130-case matrix.

questions: Does the untouched differential package remain free of PDF rule 6 findings?
What report formats and stable identifiers can the validator export?
Does repeated validation produce byte-stable or semantically stable reports?
Does the official validator emit 6.1 before or together with package/checksum findings?
Does one unreadable leaf prevent remaining PDF rules from being evaluated?
What object/path is reported?
Does numeric /XYZ zoom trigger rule 6.8 as a warning?
Is the bookmark title or object location included in the report?
Does the validator distinguish /XYZ null from /Fit and other fit destinations?
Can the official validator open the PDF without prompting?
Does it emit 6.19 but not 6.21?
Which permission restriction is named, if any?
Does encryption itself trigger the rule even when all content can be opened?
Does the validator emit both 6.21 and 6.19, only 6.21, or a package-level open failure?
Does password protection suppress all subsequent PDF analysis?
How is the failure represented in exported reports?
Does a final non-linearized PDF trigger 6.22 as information?
Does the validator detect stale or invalid linearization, not merely the dictionary marker?
Is the rule skipped at officially exempt nodes?
Does a used non-Base-14 Type1 font without FontDescriptor/font program trigger 6.26?
Does the report name the font and page?
Are unused font resources ignored?
